title: Atomic Task Decomposition Skill — Output Schema

tasks.description: Array of atomic tasks produced by decomposition. All must be S or M complexity.

decomposition_rationale.description: Explanation of the decomposition decisions: why this number of tasks, how criteria were split.

parent_component.description: Name of the parent architectural component from Architecture.md.

xl_eliminated.description: Confirms that no XL tasks exist in the output. Must be true for plan to proceed.

coverage_confirmed.description: Confirms that all input acceptance_criteria are covered by at least one output task.
